responsibility: This definition file is the canonical table of AArch64 architecture levels that the GCC port recognizes for -march handling and related feature inference. Each AARCH64_ARCH entry names an architecture revision, ties it to a representative core, assigns an internal architecture identifier and major version, and lists the ISA feature flags implied by that architecture; other backend code includes this file to build enums, option parsing data, architecture-to-feature closures, and driver-facing architecture descriptions.
